center_scalar.meaning: int rho |A0|^2 = 6 int rho + (1/2) int rho h^2 - int rho e

diagonal_center.meaning: int rho |d_s|^2 = 12 int rho + int rho h^2 - 2 int rho e
diagonal_center.exact_floor: normalized center anisotropy energy >= 12 when e=0
diagonal_center.ambient_defect_floor: if |Ric_4+3g|_op<=delta at reflection center, |e|<=4delta, so normalized energy >=12-8delta

exact_core_flux.net_signed_flux: Q(r)=integral rho d_n dmu is constant and Q(0)=0, hence Q(R)=0
exact_core_flux.boundary_pairing: F(R)=integral_outer (d-c) rho d_n dmu = integral_core rho |grad d|^2 dmu
exact_core_flux.radial_derivative: F'(r)=N(r)+Z(r), F=integral (d-c) rho d_n dmu, N,Z>=0
exact_core_flux.center_slope: F'(0)=Z(0)>=12 Vol(center quotient) in the exact diagonal scalar-minus-six center
exact_core_flux.scope: A center-slope floor gives no geometry-uniform positive thickness without coefficient/regularity control
